correctness.rationale: For all integer n>=3, g>1, 0<h<1, the fixed-point symmetry proof forces n-1 equal majority coordinates. Clearing strictly positive denominators yields the exact y(y-1)(A-By) factor, proving completeness and feasibility. Direct two-by-two Perron calculations give h0 and h1, the published convergence and boundary theorems supply the stochastic almost-sure alternatives, vanishing increments rule out cycling among distinct equilibria, and a factored positive determinant establishes interior local stability. The h_flip and width identities are exact. Standard-library rational checker verifies 4032 polynomial identities and 288 separate interior/stability cases; these finite checks are not substituted for proof.

value.rationale: A single strongly biased minority individual facing n-1 contrary-biased individuals is a canonical public-opinion stress test. The model-specific exact classification resolves the source paper’s uncertainty about interior equilibria for a natural infinite family, isolates a strictly positive persistence interval and a separate sharp public-majority-inversion line, and supplies n-dependent quantitative thresholds potentially useful for influence studies. It is neither arbitrary parameter slicing nor a table recomputation; the uniqueness and stochastic limiting-vector conclusions are logically stronger than published convergence-to-set statements in this family.
